title: Authorization to Modify Provisions for Publicly Accessible Open Spaces and Private Streets

blocks.html: The City Planning Commission may authorize modification of the provisions of Sections 136-323 (Private streets) and 136-324 (Publicly accessible open space requirements), provided that the Commission shall find that:
blocks.plainText: The City Planning Commission may authorize modification of the provisions of Sections 136-323 (Private streets) and 136-324 (Publicly accessible open space requirements), provided that the Commission shall find that:

blocks.html: (a)        the usefulness and attractiveness of the publicly accessible open space will be improved by the proposed design and layout;
blocks.plainText: (a) the usefulness and attractiveness of the publicly accessible open space will be improved by the proposed design and layout;

blocks.html: (b)        such modification to private street provisions will result in a private street network that will ensure pedestrian and vehicular mobility and safety and will be well integrated with the surrounding streets; and
blocks.plainText: (b) such modification to private street provisions will result in a private street network that will ensure pedestrian and vehicular mobility and safety and will be well integrated with the surrounding streets; and

blocks.html: (c)        such modification will result in a superior urban design relationship with surrounding buildings and open areas, including streets and private streets.
blocks.plainText: (c) such modification will result in a superior urban design relationship with surrounding buildings and open areas, including streets and private streets.

blocks.html: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and controls to enhance the relationship of such publicly accessible open spaces and private streets to surrounding buildings and open areas.
blocks.plainText: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and controls to enhance the relationship of such publicly accessible open spaces and private streets to surrounding buildings and open areas.

subsections.label: (a)
subsections.plainText: (a) the usefulness and attractiveness of the publicly accessible open space will be improved by the proposed design and layout;

subsections.label: (b)
subsections.plainText: (b) such modification to private street provisions will result in a private street network that will ensure pedestrian and vehicular mobility and safety and will be well integrated with the surrounding streets; and

subsections.label: (c)
subsections.plainText: (c) such modification will result in a superior urban design relationship with surrounding buildings and open areas, including streets and private streets.
